prompt: Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Follow this exact sequence: "Breakfast begins" -> "Boil water" -> "Add oats" -> "Cook porridge" -> "Serve breakfast" -> "Breakfast ready".
